card.name: Scattered mid-sentence drug label words
card.fires_on: No single word type fits. It fires on mixed positions in drug label text, such as 'remain', 'to', a comma, the start of 'SKYRIZI' or 'SKYCLARYS', and 'skin' in skin testing.

modes.label: Brand name starts
modes.description: The first piece of brand names beginning with SK, such as SKYRIZI and SKYCLARYS.
modes.example: Obtain liver enzymes and bilirubin levels prior to initiating treatment with<< SK>>YRIZI.

modes.label: Skin testing words
modes.description: The word skin in allergy skin test instructions.
modes.example: Most<< skin>> reactions will develop within 5-1

modes.label: Mid-sentence linking words
modes.description: Verbs, 'to' or commas inside a sentence about drug effects.
modes.example: The adrenergic receptors<< remain>> sensitive during treatment with methyldopa

card.plain: It reacts to a loose mix of words in drug labels, with no single theme, though a few brand names starting with SK and the word skin stand out.
